# Commits exempted from the no-commit-trailers gate — a RATCHET, not an allowlist.
#
# Entries may only be REMOVED, never added. A new commit carrying a banned
# trailer must be fixed before it lands, not recorded here. The gate has no
# mechanism to add to this file, and adding one would defeat the rule.
#
# WHY THESE FOUR EXIST
#
# The repository's `.git/config` on the maintainer's workstation carried a local
# override of `user.name = test` / `user.email = test@test`, shadowing the
# correct global identity (`mrveiss` / martins.veiss@gmail.com). Branch commits
# were therefore authored as `test <test@test>`, and GitHub's squash-merge
# stamped that identity onto the resulting commit as a `Co-authored-by:` trailer.
#
# The gate correctly rejected them: a `Co-authored-by:` naming neither the
# commit's own author, nor the owner, nor a bot reads as a genuine third-party
# human co-author, which is exactly what the rule exists to prevent
# (`no-commit-trailers.yml`, #13654).
#
# The trailers are not real attribution. `test <test@test>` is not a person; it
# is a misconfigured identity, since corrected by unsetting the local override so
# the global one applies. Nothing is being concealed by exempting them.
#
# WHY NOT REWRITE THEM
#
# Stripping the trailers means rewriting history from the earliest offender
# (26 commits) and force-pushing `Dev_new_gui`. Roughly 32 worktrees and several
# concurrent sessions are based on that branch; every one would need re-basing,
# and the project's own rules forbid force-pushing a shared branch. That is a
# real operational risk traded for a cosmetic correction.
#
# These surfaced only when a release PR first scanned the whole `main..Dev_new_gui`
# range; per-PR scans never saw them, because the trailer was added BY the squash
# merge rather than being present on the branch.
#
# One SHA per line. Everything after `#` is a comment.

42c8779f8e0f28c73a2294693c5dfc000c09de50  # fix(hooks): report unlanded worktree branches (#15294, #15295)
36a1e7d25f64f1df2fff9a9ae02428736f9d0a3f  # ci(perf): stop docs-only PRs running the sweep and image build (#15299, #15300)
ffc37c6f9cda65783f469f92e91d4cf9978ceca5  # ci(runners): move code-quality and the pre-commit gate to self-hosted (#15310, #15311)
